此工作流程可帮助您将文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。这是我之前发布的 Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF 文本到图像工作流程的修改版本，它使用简洁的 Flux.2 Klein 4B ALL-in-One safetensor 模型来替换 GGUF 模型，但仍然可以在 8GB VRAM GPU 上表现良好（发布此版本的发行商也有一个较小的 AIO safetensor 版本，如果您想尝试，可以运行 4 到 6GB VRAM 机器，他们还发布了一个针对16 GB VRAM 机器）。如果您知道如何修改工作流程，您还可以将这种人类可读的简单提示保护技巧应用于其他工作流程（不仅限于 Flux.2 Klein）。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。还与 使用 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将元数据嵌入工作流程本身或单独保存工作流程。

Flux.2 Klein 4B 和 9B 型号是高速 AI 图像生成器的新系列，它使用“整流流”架构将图像生成和专业级编辑统一到一个紧凑的软件包中。这些模型比旧版本要快得多，因为它们使用“逐步蒸馏”，这使得它们只需 4 个步骤即可创建高质量图像 - 在现代硬件上实现亚秒级速度 - 而不是以前模型所需的数十个步骤。 4B 变体是在允许个人和商业用途的 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布的，而功能更强大的 9B 变体则使用旨在用于研究和个人项目的非商业许可证。两种型号均支持 11 种原生宽高比，范围从 1:1 方形到 21:9 超宽和 9:21 垂直，并且可以生成高达 4 兆像素的清晰图像（例如 2048x2048）。为了让他们更加 易于访问，有 Q（量化）模型，如 FP8（8 位）和 NVFP4（4 位）版本，可减少模型的“大脑大小”以节省内存；具体来说，FP8 版本的速度提高了约 1.6 倍，并且使用的 VRAM 减少了 40%，而 NVFP4 版本的速度提高了 2.7 倍，并且使用的 VRAM 减少了 55%。由于这些优化，4B 型号可以在具有低至 8GB 至 12GB VRAM 的系统上运行，甚至可以在极低等级的 6GB、4GB、2GB VRAM GPU 上运行（使用最低的 Flux.2 Klein 4B Q2 或 Q3 GGUF），甚至可以在最新笔记本电脑或迷你 PC 芯片的现代集成显卡 (iGPU) 上运行。

您可以从CivitAI下载您所需的AIO模型和所使用的LORA（详情见下文）。确保您拥有足够最新的 ComfyUI 安装，支持 Flux.2 Klein，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件（AIO 模型、LORA 等）放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Z-Image Turbo 和 Flux 的其他工作流程。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Flux.2 Klein 4B ALL-in-One 型号，然后立即选择

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

o.en:
This workflow helps you to save your Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. This is modified version of my earlier published Flux.2 Klein 4B GGUF Text-to-Image Workflow, this uses a neat Flux.2 Klein 4B ALL-in-One safetensor model to swap out the GGUF model but still can perform well on 8GB VRAM GPU (the publisher that published this also have a smaller AIO safetensor version that may run 4 to 6GB VRAM machines if you wanna try, also they published a AIO version aimed for 16 GB VRAM machines). If you know how to modify workflows you can also implement this human readable easy prompt saver trick to other workflows as well (not limited to just Flux.2 Klein). You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used you may embed the metadata with workflow itself or save the workflow for your work seperately.

The Flux.2 Klein 4B and 9B models are a new family of high-speed AI image generators that use a "rectified flow" architecture to unify image generation and professional-grade editing into a single, compact package. These models are significantly faster than older versions because they use "step-distillation," which allows them to create high-quality images in just 4 steps—achieving sub-second speeds on modern hardware—rather than the dozens of steps required by previous models. The 4B variant is released under a permissive Apache 2.0 License for both personal and commercial use, while the more powerful 9B variant uses a Non-Commercial License intended for research and personal projects. Both models support 11 native aspect ratios ranging from 1:1 square to 21:9 ultrawide and 9:21 vertical, and they can produce sharp images up to 4 megapixels (such as 2048x2048). To make them even more accessible, there are Q (Quantized) models like the FP8 (8-bit) and NVFP4 (4-bit) versions, which reduce the "brain size" of the model to save memory; specifically, the FP8 version is about 1.6x faster and uses 40% less VRAM, while the NVFP4 version is up to 2.7x faster and uses 55% less VRAM. Because of these optimizations, the 4B model can run on systems with as little as 8GB to 12GB of VRAM and can even operate (with the lowest Flux.2 Klein 4B Q2 or Q3 GGUFs) on very low grade 6GB, 4GB, 2GB VRAM GPUs or even on modern integrated graphics (iGPUs) from the latest laptop or mini PC chips.

You can download your necessary AIO model and LORA used from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation that supports Flux.2 Klein and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files (AIO model, LORAs etc) in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Z-Image Turbo and Flux. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Flux.2 Klein 4B ALL-in-One model first and now

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, too add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button
